title: Global payroll
text: Remote helps companies run global payroll for distributed employees and contractors. Teams can pay workers in multiple countries, manage country-specific payroll rules, keep payroll connected to HR workflows, and reduce manual compliance work when hiring internationally.

title: Employer of Record
text: Remote's employer of record service helps companies hire employees in countries where they do not have a local entity. It supports onboarding, employment documentation, local payroll, benefits, and compliance obligations.

title: Country explorer
text: Remote's country explorer helps teams understand local hiring, payroll, benefits, public holidays, taxes, and compliance requirements before expanding into a new country.

title: Pricing
text: Remote pricing paths help buyers compare HR, payroll, contractor management, and employer-of-record products. Buyers can review product packages and choose the right plan before booking a walkthrough.

title: Contractor management
text: Remote helps companies onboard, manage, and pay international contractors while keeping contractor workflows connected to HR operations and compliance review.
